correctness.rationale: The local thresholds are necessary because two white ordinary vertices in the same clique cannot receive the first force. At simultaneous equality with both bridge endpoints white, no force exists. In every other threshold-admissible case, one clique can be completed, the bridge endpoint can be forced if needed, and then the other clique can be completed. The exact generating polynomial follows by independent local selection and subtraction of the single forbidden structural type. Direct exhaustive color-change simulation confirms the result for all 25 parameter pairs with 3 <= a,b <= 7.
